validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="a">
  <state id="a">
    <onentry>
      <send event="ping" tage="#_internal"/>
    </onentry>
    <transition event="ping" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

notes: the W3C SCXML 1.0 schema rejects this under XML Schema constraint `cvc-complex-type.3.2.2`: Attribute 'tage' is not allowed for this element
spec_references: XML Schema 1.0 Part 1 §3.4.4 Element Locally Valid (Complex Type) (`cvc-complex-type.3.2.2`)

fixes.message: `<send>` has an attribute with a similar name: `target`
`<send>` has an attribute with a similar name: `type`
